messages.raw:
From: Dr. Ada Mensah <a.mensah@university.example>
To: demo@local.test
Subject: Changed: CS4020 project presentation now {{+17d}}
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Message-ID: <uni-5512@university.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"

Dear student,

I need to inform you of a change to the CS4020 schedule. The project presentation
date has been moved from {{+10d}} to {{+17d}}, and the presentation time slot
has changed from 09:00 to 14:00 in Room B2.

Please note that the submission deadline for the written report is unchanged and
remains {{+15d}}. You are required to submit the report through the module
portal by that date.

Why this matters: the presentation and the report are assessed as a single unit,
so missing either deadline affects your grade significantly. Groups who presented
on the original date have already been allocated presentation slots, so you
cannot revert to the earlier date.

Action: confirm the new date in your group, and make sure the report is uploaded
by {{+15d}}. If the new date conflicts with another commitment, reply to this
message today so we can arrange an alternative slot.

Best regards,
Dr. Ada Mensah
Module Convenor, CS4020
